tools.name: menu-map-20261019.json
tools.description: Map an avatar's real radial menu after VRCFury and Modular Avatar build it: a Unity tool exports a disposable test build's menu, icons and synced parameters, and the page draws the menu to click through with a 256-bit parameter budget per add-on.
tools.command_template: Copy scripts/unity-editor/menu-map-20261019.cs into Assets/UnityUnicorn/Editor/, select the avatar, then run Tools > Unity Unicorn > menu-map
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with the VRChat Avatars SDK; VRCFury and Modular Avatar are built in when the avatar uses them.
An avatar with a VRC Avatar Descriptor in an open scene, outside Play mode.
limitations: Read only: the test copy is deleted afterwards and the scene is never saved, but Unity may still mark the scene as changed.
Which add-on a parameter belongs to is read from the top menu that uses it; parameters folded by VRCFury's compressor are an estimate.
The page's 'Load a menu map' keeps your file in that browser tab only.
